lowGravity.name: Eradicator Hop Rock Fury Assault Rifle

mechanics.name: Balloons
mechanics.note: Lift and reduced gravity prevent a fall while balloons remain attached.

mechanics.name: Bouncer
mechanics.note: The placed bouncer launches players and vehicles; the launch grants fall protection.

mechanics.name: Chiller Grenade
mechanics.note: The impact displaces players and gives icy feet; it does not cancel fall damage.

mechanics.name: Crash Pad
mechanics.note: Landing on the deployed pad launches the player safely; opponents can also be bounced.

mechanics.name: Crash Pad Jr.
mechanics.note: The small pad launches players on contact without landing damage.

mechanics.name: Flint-Knock Pistol
mechanics.note: An uncrouched shot displaces both the user and the target.

mechanics.name: The Dub
mechanics.note: The article explicitly identifies The Dub as sharing the pistol’s knockback behavior.

mechanics.name: Grapple Blade
mechanics.note: A connected grapple grants protection through the following landing; grounded attacks displace targets.

mechanics.name: Grappler
mechanics.note: A successful surface connection protects the following landing; missed shots are not protected.

mechanics.name: Hop Rock
mechanics.note: Its low-gravity effect prevents landing damage while active.

mechanics.name: Impulse Grenade
mechanics.note: Its blast launches players but does not grant fall protection.

mechanics.name: Jetpack
mechanics.note: Thrust provides flight while fueled; fuel loss can still cause landing damage.

mechanics.name: Jump Pad (Directional)
mechanics.note: The original directional floor trap launches players horizontally with fall protection.

mechanics.name: Kinetic Blade
mechanics.note: The second slash displaces an enemy; the user’s dash cancels falling damage.

mechanics.name: Launch Pad
mechanics.note: The launch returns a player to skydiving and permits glider deployment.

mechanics.name: Mechanical Shockwave Bow
mechanics.note: The charged projectile applies shockwave displacement with fall protection.

mechanics.name: Nimbus Cloud (Kintoun)
mechanics.note: Activation breaks colliding structures and opens a cloud glide; cancelling the glide is safe.

mechanics.name: Pepper Mint
mechanics.note: Consumption grants a temporary movement-speed increase.

mechanics.name: Rift-To-Go
mechanics.note: Activation teleports the user into the sky with glider deployment.

mechanics.name: Rift Fish
mechanics.note: Consumption produces the same functional rift as a Rift-To-Go.

mechanics.name: Rocket Ram
mechanics.note: Thrust and landing can break structures; it is also a traversal tool.

mechanics.name: Shadow Stone
mechanics.note: Shadow form grants invisibility, faster movement and protected falls only while the form remains active.

mechanics.name: Shockwave Grenade
mechanics.note: The shockwave protects displaced players; a player propelled through a build breaks that build.

mechanics.name: Shockwave Hammer
mechanics.note: The slam breaks builds and displaces opponents; its bounce protects the user’s landing.

mechanics.name: Sideways Scythe
mechanics.note: Swings damage builds; its leap gained landing protection after the original unsafe implementation.

mechanics.name: Silver Surfer’s Board
mechanics.note: Activation opens a surfboard glide, and cancelling early does not cause landing damage.

mechanics.name: Spicy Fish
mechanics.note: Consumption grants a temporary speed effect.

mechanics.name: Airbending
mechanics.note: Air Wheel has a sprint boost; Air Jump also launches nearby opponents.

mechanics.name: War Machine’s Hover Jets
mechanics.note: The jets provide sustained powered flight; sprinting accelerates it while consuming more fuel.

mechanics.name: Wings of Icarus
mechanics.note: Holding the wings protects falls; the dive bomb damages builds and displaces enemies.

mechanics.name: Witch Broom
mechanics.note: The upward burst breaks intersecting builds and opens a cancellable safe glide.

mechanics.name: Slurp Barrel
mechanics.note: Destroying a normal barrel near the player restores effective health. Quest-only inert barrels do not qualify.

mechanics.name: Zipline
mechanics.note: Attaching and dismounting cancels falling damage.

mechanics.name: Ascender
mechanics.note: Vertical transport protects falls until landing and can clear a blocking structure.

mechanics.name: Geyser
mechanics.note: A vent burst launches the player and permits a glider.

mechanics.name: Slipstream
mechanics.note: The wind tunnel transports players; exiting permits glider deployment.

mechanics.name: Grind Rail
mechanics.note: Grinding provides transport along the rail and allows faster grinding through sprint input.

mechanics.name: Kinetic Ore
mechanics.note: A struck rock launches and can carry a player standing on it.
